notes: ROBOTS: https://www.anthropologie.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST, before any other request on the host - HTTP 200, 962 bytes, profile chrome131, quoted in full below in substance. It names NO Claude agent: there is no ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot or anthropic-ai group anywhere in the file, so there is no named-agent Disallow and no hard stop. Exactly two groups exist. 'User-agent: *' opens 'Allow: /' and then disallows /orchestration/, /api/, /cgi-bin/, /blog/wp-content/, /homepage, /en-gb/homepage, /fr-fr/homepage, /de-de/homepage, '/*search?', /claims, /order-tracking, /order/, /password/reset, and carries 'Crawl-delay: 10'. The only other group is 'User-agent: Pinterest' with Crawl-delay 120, which is not us. COMPLIANCE: probe.MIN_GAP was raised to 10.0 s for this host for the whole session, so every request honoured the declared Crawl-delay 10 (probe.py's 2 s default would have breached it). '/api/' is disallowed, so NO storefront product API was called at any point - every count below comes from the server-rendered listing HTML instead. No '*search?' URL, no /homepage, no /order or /account path was ever requested. ACCESS: plain direct probe.py curl_cffi fetches (chrome131, chrome120, firefox133, safari17_0, safari17_2_ios, safari18_0, safari18_0_ios) - no proxy, no r.jina.ai, no campaign parameter, no browser automation; zero 403s and no bot wall. UK STOREFRONT IDENTIFICATION - this was the first thing established, because anthropologie.com is a shared host and a prior pass already covered the US storefront. The UK storefront is the /en-gb/ locale path: robots.txt itself advertises a separate 'Sitemap: https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/sitemapindex.xml' beside the bare US one, that index yields /en-gb/categories_sitemap.xml (1,093 category URLs, 787 of them non-facet), pages under it render prices in GBP with the 'English (£)' locale switch, and titles end '| Anthropologie UK'. Every URL in rows[] and review[] is an /en-gb/ path except the single US entry that is explicitly labelled out of scope. QTY SOURCE: the exact figure printed by the listing page itself, verbatim 'N products', rendered server-side in the HTML - no API (robots forbids /api/), no JSON-LD numberOfItems (a documented trap that caps at 100), no meta-description number, no nav-attribute count. VERIFICATION - every count was reconciled against a direct count of the page's own product tiles, div.o-pwa-product-tile, page by page. Bathroom Hardware: header '138 products'; page 1 renders 72 tiles, page 2 renders 66, page 3 renders 0 - 72+66 = 138 exactly, so the recorded 138 is a full enumeration, not a first-page artifact, and the page size is 72. WHY ONLY ONE LEAF: Anthropologie UK is not a bathroom retailer - it has no sanitaryware, no basins, sinks, toilets or bidets, no baths, no showers or shower systems, no enclosures or screens, no taps or mixers, no bathroom mirror category and no bathroom storage category. The index holds 44 anthropologie.com URLs, 20 on the bare US path and 24 on /en-gb/, confirming both storefronts were touched by earlier passes.
